i18n.enTitle: What is the future of AI agents? Explaining market forecasts and evolution until 2030
i18n.enSummary: While we have seen the phrase "the first year of AI agents," we have also heard that the results have not been as promising as expected, and many people are unsure whether or not this is a technology that will truly grow. In conclusion, it can be said that the future potential of AI agents is high. However, this is also a time of high expectations, and not all implementations will be successful. If you jump on the bandwagon without knowing the basis, you will continue to spend your budget on verification that will not produce results. On the other hand, if you continue to wait and see, you will be able to differentiate yourself in terms of productivity from your competitors who have automated their work.
